data.one_liner: Web and WASM HTTP client adapter for Dio.
data.what_it_does: Provides the underlying browser HTTP client adapter (BrowserHttpClientAdapter) for Dio on the web platform, including WASM support. It handles browser-based networking via XMLHttpRequest and triggers browser downloads with Blob URLs. Most users access it automatically through the main Dio package.
use_when: You need to explicitly configure browser-specific Dio settings such as withCredentials or CORS warnings.
You need custom or pinned web adapter behavior when using Dio on Flutter Web or Dart Web.
avoid_when: You only target non-web platforms (IO/native mobile and desktop).
You are using standard Dio configuration without needing direct web adapter adjustments, as it is already embedded in Dio.
strengths: Supports both standard JS and WebAssembly (WASM) environments.
Enables file downloads on web using Blob URLs and browser download anchors.
Provides built-in CORS preflight warnings and enriched error messages.
weaknesses: Downloads must buffer the entire response into memory before triggering the browser download.
File append modes and local deleteOnError are not supported on web.
data.setup_notes: Already embedded inside package:dio; explicit dependency is optional.
